title: Concept: Cargo dependency declared with an open lower bound
description: Cargo.toml declares a `>=` requirement with no upper bound, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: Every later major satisfies the requirement, so Cargo can resolve an incompatible or compromised release the project never tested.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through Cargo.toml (cargo).
risk: Every later major satisfies the requirement, so Cargo can resolve an incompatible or compromised release the project never tested.
